Nikon Preset 0.6.0-beta - Photo live delivery and validation
Date: 2026-10-17 (Asia/Shanghai)

ARTIFACT
Application: com.nikonpreset.usbprobe
Version: code26 / 0.6.0-beta
File: dist/nikon-usb-0.6.0-beta-debug.apk
Size: 2781817 bytes
SHA-256: 00ac0cf7c6dae130e059dbd532359f1a8c83713e10ba16db1d223ac65d336005
Android build and v2/v3 signature verification passed. The observations below
used this frozen artifact. No production files changed after the final build.

IMPLEMENTED
Album has a Photo Live tab and an explicit Start/Stop action. Enabling creates
an existing-photo baseline, then receives new JPEGs on the owned read-only
PTP/IP session. ObjectAdded events wake bounded serialized work; same-session
index checks compensate for missing events. A camera-generated preview is
published before an original receive is scheduled. No shutter command is sent.
Originals use temporary files, metadata/size/JPEG validation, deterministic
destinations and durable completion identities. Duplicate notifications do not
create repeated original transfers. Completed app files are also published to
MediaStore Pictures/相机预设 on Android29+, using pending/verify/publish and
durable recovery records. Android26-28 retain app files without a new legacy
storage permission. Gallery failure retains the app original for publication
retry; it does not repeat the network download.
Queue and state belong to the application controller, not Activity callbacks.
They survive ordinary page changes/background/Activity recreation. Stop stops
new receive work while preserving the connection. Preset handoff pauses live
work and drains the serialized read before ownership transfer. No automatic
reconnect, write replay or restart of live mode is added.
Pending queue128 and success history120 have bounded admission; unfinished and
failed identities remain retryable up to a total256 records. Capacity waiting
does not consume the camera-response retry budget.

AUTOMATED VALIDATION / REVIEW
Full core10309 + full probe12089 + synthetic live server51 = 22449 checks pass.
Core includes PTP/IP4459 and production AlbumController446. Tests cover event
ownership, baseline, preview-before-original, duplicates/missing events,
metadata-unready/DeviceBusy retry, invalid data/transaction termination,
durable app-file recovery, publisher-only retry, stop/disconnect/handoff and
bounded capacity recovery. Final logs: app/build/v060-final-core.log,
v060-final-probe.log and v060-final-live-server.log. The older standalone
album log includes a corrected test-fixture directory error, not final failure.
Tests use a repository-local temporary directory because the Windows sandbox's
redirected system TEMP prevented rename in the cache fixture. Production cache
implementation was not changed to work around that environment limitation.
Scoped source review found and resolved queue-capacity retry exhaustion,
unfinished-history eviction, preview-readiness refresh and stopped retry UI.
Precise detail-original recovery also handles successfully trimmed history.
No remaining P1/P2 was reported within that reviewed scope.

FINAL APK ANDROID OBSERVATIONS
Temporary Pixel9 / Android17 emulator,1080x2424, loopback synthetic camera.
Photo Live started with six baseline objects and received zero old originals.
New handles7/8/9 were automatically previewed and saved. Handle7 had duplicate
events;8 had one metadata2009 and one original2019;9 had no event. Five completed
originals total (7..11), with five MediaStore rows, all pending0. Public JPEG
sizes and SHA-256 match the source fixtures. There were six original requests
(one refused busy request, five successful data transfers), no preset writes.
HOME/background received10; clear-task/new Activity recovered the same live
queue/count on one session. While viewing10, incoming11 did not force a jump.
Stop preserved the connection; subsequently added12 was not received. Preset
capability/nine-slot read and return to Album reused the same session and did
not restart live mode. Manual disconnect ended the transport and stopped the
service; app PID9005 crash buffer was empty. Protocol CloseSession count0.
The optional repeat/fault gallery app_process probe could not run because the
delivery manifest is not debuggable. It is not counted as passed. MediaStore
success/uniqueness/hash checks above used real UI and read-only system records;
gallery crash recovery has source review rather than Android fault injection.
